brand_notes: Founder is the mid-tier line below Persona; 40B is the standmount (6in AL-MAG, 1in ceramic-dome with OSW waveguide, rear port). Paradigm states 'compatible with 8 ohms' but EAC and NTL measure ~3.1-3.5 Ω minimum (eac-paradigm-founder-40b, whathifi-paradigm-founder-40b). spinorama.org mislabels the 40B as a passive center. Made in Toronto.
takeaways: EAC Klippel: min Z 3.5 Ω, EPDR 1.8 Ω -> effectively-4ohm flag
Sensitivity 87.2 dB (EAC via spinorama.org) vs 88.5 dB (NTL) vs 89 claimed
f3 ~70 Hz, pref 4.9/7.1; no raw spinorama export so beamwidth/LW deviation left null
THD ~0.4% @86 dB, ~1.0% @96 dB, compression under ~0.7 dB at 102 dB (graph-read)
Critics (What Hi-Fi?/AHF, StereoNET, Audiophilia) praise imaging and soundstage
conflicts: Crossover 1.6 kHz claimed vs ~2.8 kHz measured by NTL
FR claim ±2 dB vs NTL ±4 dB
Pref score 4.89 (fetched) vs 4.99 in a search summary
